answer:
Based on the search results, Warren Hastings abolished the Dual System of Government in Bengal in 1772. He was the Governor-General of Bengal at that time and led the East India Company's administration.

The company is the **British East India Company**, which was founded in **1600** (specifically on December 31, 1600, when Queen Elizabeth I granted the charter).

The user is asking about a company that abolished the dual system of government in Bengal, and wants to know when that company was founded.

The "dual system of government" in Bengal refers to the "Doctrine of Lapse" and the "Permanent Settlement" system introduced by the British East India Company. Specifically, this relates to the abolition of the "Double Government" or "Dual Government" system (Diwan-Bakshi) in Bengal, which was implemented by Robert Clive and later reformed/abolished during the mid-18th century under the presidency of Warren Hastings.
